# Maintenance Schedule 2025

Issued by:   Transit Agency, Workshop


## Service intervals

| Bus type | Service every |
|---|---:|
| Diesel | 10,000 km |
| Hybrid | 12,000 km |
| Electric | 15,000 km |


## Status on 30 June 2025

- Buses overdue for service: 18.

- Workshop capacity: 22 services per week.

- Main cause of the backlog: 4 vacant mechanic positions.
